topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Finding that old teddy bear at a yard sale, I couldn’t help but linger over it. The fur was worn, the button eyes dulled by time, yet there was something undeniably familiar in the way it sat, slightly tilted, as if waiting. I felt a sudden urge to grab it, to pull it close, but my hands hesitated, hovering just above. What if touching it unraveled more than just threads? Memories aren’t toys to be picked up and played with; they belong in their cages, safely locked away. Still, the temptation was there, a quiet whisper urging me to reclaim a piece of my past. I walked away without it, the air feeling a little thinner, a little colder.
